caption: The drawing depicts a single light-colored dress, predominantly beige or off-white in hue, with a high waistline and a flowing skirt that extends to the floor, trailing to the right side. The dress features short, puffed sleeves with a gathered texture, and a square neckline edged with a darker trim or lace. The bodice and skirt of the dress are decorated with a subtle repeating dotted pattern. The hem of the skirt is adorned with a wide decorative band featuring a scalloped or lattice-like design, interspersed with teardrop-shaped embellishments, and finished with a thin band of pleated trim at the bottom. The background is plain and unadorned, and the entire composition centers the dress, with no other objects visible. The artist’s name, Gertrude L. M. S. L., is written in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Wedding Dress
